question: Mayank Chakraborty has officially become India’s 94th Grandmaster and the first-ever Grandmaster from which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **16-year-old Mayank Chakraborty has become India’s 94th Grandmaster (GM) and the first from the North East region.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Historic Achievement:** Mayank is the first-ever Grandmaster from the state of Assam and the entire North Eastern region of India.
 
• **Final Norm:** He secured his final GM norm at the 8th Grandmaster Tournament held in Sweden.
 
• **Rating Milestone:** To achieve the title, he crossed the mandatory **2500 FIDE rating barrier**.
 
• **Tournament Performance:** He finished first in the tournament with **7 points out of 9**, maintaining an unbeaten streak in the final rounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Grandmaster (GM) Title__

 
 
• The Grandmaster title is awarded by FIDE (International Chess Federation). It is the highest title a chess player can attain, apart from World Champion. Once achieved, the title is held for life.
